pieces.tagline: The deep, hypnotic lines of natural malachite framed in structural gold.
pieces.name: Verdant I Ring
pieces.story:
A striking, sculptural statement piece, Verdant I celebrates the hypnotic, fluid patterns of natural malachite. The design frames the rich green stone within bold, architectural lines of hand-shaped metal, balancing raw organic beauty with refined sophistication. It stands as a quietly powerful addition for the conscious collector of wearable art.

Handcrafted via the traditional lost-wax technique by a single master artisan, this limited-edition artefact is engineered for an elegant, comfortable fit. The deliberate surface marks and textures are preserved as the proud signature of the maker—serving as tangible proof of a human touch in a machine-made age.
